parametrized_description: An audio company makes wired and wireless headphones. The wired team can produce at most MaxWiredProduction per day and the wireless team at most MaxWirelessProduction per day. A shared testing machine has capacity MaxTestingCapacity per day. Profit is ProfitWired per wired headphone and ProfitWireless per wireless headphone. Maximize profit.

MaxWiredProduction.description: Maximum wired headphones produced per day

MaxWirelessProduction.description: Maximum wireless headphones produced per day

MaxTestingCapacity.description: Maximum capacity of shared audio testing machine per day

NumWired.description: Number of wired headphones to produce per day

NumWireless.description: Number of wireless headphones to produce per day

constraints.description: Wired production must not exceed team capacity.
Wireless production must not exceed team capacity.
Total production must not exceed shared testing machine capacity.

objective.description: Maximize total profit from headphone production.
